title: United Nations World Population Prospects: 2022 Revision

custodian.agency: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA)

epistemic_provenance.methodology: Probabilistic demographic projections using Bayesian hierarchical models for total fertility and life expectancy at birth, combined with cohort-component projection methods across 237 distinct countries and areas.
epistemic_provenance.historical_reconstruction_period: 1950 - 2021 (Empirical vital registration, census data, demographic and health surveys DHS)
epistemic_provenance.probabilistic_projection_period: 2022 - 2100 (Medium variant median trajectory, 80% and 95% prediction intervals)
epistemic_provenance.scientific_peer_review: United Nations Population Division (2022) World Population Prospects 2022: Methodology of the United Nations Population Estimates and Projections, UN DESA/POP/CPD/2022/1.
